{{Top|leg}}
'''EG-05''' was an [[EG-5 Jedi Hunter droid]] employed by the Separatists. Circa [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] was sent to destroy a droid factory controlled by the Separatists, where he encountered the lightsaber-wielding droid. After a fierce [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]], Skywalker managed to slice into its shoulder, allowing him to unleash an onslaught of slashes before throwing it into an electrode, causing the droid to explode.
